description: This file defines API routes for insights in a FastAPI-based dashboard backend. It includes data models for insights, functions to analyze KPI trends, and an endpoint to retrieve insights summaries and highlights.

classes.name: InsightSummary
classes.description: Model representing a high-level summary insight for a file, KPI set, or dashboard.

classes.name: InsightsResponse
classes.description: Response model containing a list of InsightSummary objects.

methods.name: collect_kpi_trends(db: AsyncIOMotorDatabase, filename: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Asynchronously collects KPI trend data from the database, optionally filtered by filename.

methods.name: basic_stats_for_kpi(values)
methods.description: Calculates basic statistics (mean, std dev, min, max, count) for a list of KPI values.

methods.name: generate_kpi_highlights(kpi_stats: Dict[str, Dict], file_kpis: List[Dict])
methods.description: Generates highlight strings for KPIs where outliers are detected based on standard deviations.

methods.name: str basic_narrative_for_kpis(file_kpi: Dict, kpi_stats: Dict[str, Dict])
methods.description: Creates a narrative summary comparing KPI values against their statistics.

methods.name: get_summary_insights( filename: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="If provided, restrict insights to a single file"), db: AsyncIOMotorDatabase = Depends(get_database) )
methods.description: API endpoint that aggregates KPI data to produce insights, trends, and highlights for files or system-wide.

ctags.name: basic_narrative_for_kpis
ctags.pattern: /^def basic_narrative_for_kpis(file_kpi: Dict, kpi_stats: Dict[str, Dict]) -> str:$/

ctags.name: collect_kpi_trends
ctags.pattern: /^async def collect_kpi_trends(db: AsyncIOMotorDatabase, filename: Optional[str] = None):$/

ctags.name: filename
ctags.pattern: /^    filename: Optional[str] = Field(None, description="Filename if applicable")$/

ctags.name: get_summary_insights
ctags.signature: ( filename: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="If provided, restrict insights to a single file"), db: AsyncIOMotorDatabase = Depends(get_database) )

ctags.name: highlights
ctags.pattern: /^    highlights: List[str] = Field(..., description="List of highlight events, trends, or outlier/

ctags.name: kpi_changes
ctags.pattern: /^    kpi_changes: Optional[List[dict]] = Field(None, description="Key changes or anomalies in KPI/

ctags.name: summary
ctags.pattern: /^    summary: str = Field(..., description="High-level summary insight (natural language)")$/
